title: MLModel - Data API
description: Represents an AI model that can be used in Einstein Prediction Builder, Einstein Recommendation Builder, and other Einstein features. This object is available in API version 53.0 and later.

ApprovalStatus.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ApprovalStatus.description: Indicates whether the model is approved, pending approval, or rejected. Possible values are: Approved Pending Rejected The default value is Pending.

Dataset.description: The ID of the dataset used to create the model.

ModelType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ModelType.description: Indicates the type of model. Possible values are: BinaryClassification DecisionTree DeepLearningIntent DeepLearningNER GeneralizedLinearModels GlobalDeepLearningIntent GlobalDeepLearningNER GlobalLanguageDetection GradientBoostedTrees LinearRegression LinearSupportVectorClassifiers LogisticRegression MulticlassClassification NaiveBayes NeuralNet PopularityCount RandomForest Regression XGBoost

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The automatically generated ID that uniquely identifies the model.

PredictionDefinitionId.description: The ID of the related prediction definition. This field is a relationship field.

RecommendationDefinitionId.description: The ID of the related recommendation definition. This field is a relationship field.

ScoringStatus.description: Indicates whether scoring is enabled or disabled. Possible values are: Disabled Enabled

TrainingEndTime.description: Indicates the date and time when the training ended.

TrainingStartTime.description: Indicates the date and time when the training started.
